'''October 2000 St. Cloud tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Cloud, Minnesota on 14 October 2000. It is known from Joshua Grace's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1351">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-old-skool-strikes-back-mpls-mn-10-10d1351/ old-skool-strikes-back-mpls-mn-10-10], DeckTech (Joshua "Stormcrow" Grace, 16 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-16-old-skool-strikes-back-mpls-mn-10-10d1351/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 October 2000
* '''Site:''' St. Cloud, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
